competency_statement_fil: TESDA BHS NC II — Practice Entrepreneurial Skills in the Workplace: kinikilala ng BHW ang mga polisiyang nagbabawal o nag-aatas ng partikular na kilos sa loob ng barangay health station, naipapaliwanag ito nang malinaw sa iba, at nakapagmumungkahi ng mas episyenteng paggamit ng resources.
competency_statement_en: TESDA BHS NC II — Practice Entrepreneurial Skills in the Workplace: the BHW recognizes the policies that prohibit or require specific action inside the barangay health station, explains them clearly to others, and can propose a more efficient use of resources.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nasasabi ng BHW ang apat na polisiya (EO 51, RA 10028, AO 2015-0053, DC 2021-0486) at ang partikular na ipinagbabawal o inaatasan ng bawat isa, nang hindi tumitingin sa materyal.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW names the four policies (EO 51, RA 10028, AO 2015-0053, DC 2021-0486) and what each one specifically prohibits or requires, without looking at the material.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Naaalala lamang na 'may bawal na promosyon' nang hindi maitukoy kung aling batas ang saklaw ng gatas, gamot, o plastic.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only recalls that 'promotion is banned' without being able to say which law covers milk, medicine, or plastic.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Tama ang apat, kasama ang partikular na saklaw ng bawat isa, walang untag.
levels.kaya_na_en: Correctly states all four, including each one's specific scope, unprompted.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang dalawa o tatlo, pero nalilito sa saklaw ng natitira.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Correct on two or three, but confuses the scope of the rest.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Isa lamang o wala ang tamang natutukoy.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Correctly identifies only one, or none.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapaliwanag ng BHW na ang RA 10028 ay hindi lang pagbabawal kundi aktibong pag-atas na isulong ang breastfeeding at magkaroon ng lactation station.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW explains that RA 10028 is not only a prohibition but an active requirement to promote breastfeeding and to have a lactation station.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Inilalarawan ang RA 10028 bilang bawal lang sa gatas, hindi nailalagay ang aktibong pag-atas na isulong ang breastfeeding.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Describes RA 10028 only as a ban on milk, without connecting it to the active requirement to promote breastfeeding.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Malinaw na naiiba ang RA 10028 (aktibong pag-atas) sa EO 51 (pagbabawal), may sariling halimbawa.
levels.kaya_na_en: Clearly distinguishes RA 10028 (active requirement) from EO 51 (prohibition), with an own example.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Naiiba ang dalawa kapag tinanong, pero hindi kusang binabanggit.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Distinguishes the two when asked, but doesn't bring it up unprompted.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Pinagsasama ang RA 10028 at EO 51 bilang iisang bawal lamang.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Collapses RA 10028 and EO 51 into a single prohibition.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Naipapakita ng BHW, sa isang role-play o aktwal na sitwasyon, ang pagtanggi na kumikilala sa intensyon ng bisita, naglalahad ng batayang polisiya, at nag-aalok ng ibang paraan ng pakikipagtulungan.
observation_indicators.observable_en: In a role-play or an actual situation, the BHW shows a refusal that acknowledges the visitor's intent, states the policy basis, and offers another way to cooperate.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Tumatanggi nang walang paliwanag, o hindi talaga tumatanggi at tinatanggap ang alok.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Declines with no explanation, or does not actually decline and accepts the offer.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tatlong bahagi ang pagtanggi — pagkilala, batayan, alternatibo — nang natural at hindi robotic.
levels.kaya_na_en: The refusal has all three parts — acknowledgment, basis, alternative — delivered naturally, not robotically.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tumatanggi at may batayan, pero nakakalimutan ang alternatibong pakikipagtulungan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Declines with a basis, but forgets to offer an alternative form of cooperation.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Tumatanggap ng alok, o tumatanggi nang walang ipinaliwanag na dahilan.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Accepts the offer, or declines with no stated reason.

observation_indicators.observable_fil: Nakapagbibigay ang BHW ng tiyak na mungkahi para sa mas episyenteng paggamit ng resources sa BHS, kasama ang partikular na dahilan kung bakit ito makakatulong.
observation_indicators.observable_en: The BHW gives a specific suggestion for using resources more efficiently at the BHS, with a specific reason why it would help.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Pangkalahatang mungkahi lamang ('dapat mag-ipon ng resources') nang walang tiyak na bagay na babaguhin.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Only a general suggestion ('we should conserve resources') with no specific thing to change.

levels.kaya_na_fil: May tiyak na mungkahi at malinaw na dahilan, kayang sabihin sa midwife o kapwa BHW.
levels.kaya_na_en: Has a specific suggestion and a clear reason, ready to say to the midwife or a fellow BHW.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: May tiyak na naisip pero hindi pa maayos maisalarawan ang dahilan.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Has something specific in mind but cannot yet clearly articulate the reason.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Nananatili sa pangkalahatang mungkahi nang walang tiyak na target.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Stays at a general suggestion with no specific target.
